period_findings.explanation: The header states 'Fiscal Year Ended July 26, 2026 (2027 Q2) and July 27, 2025 (2026 Q2)'. The source document specifies the period as 'Quarter ended July 26, 2026 (three and six months shown separately)', indicating these dates are quarter ends, not fiscal year ends. Therefore, calling July 26, 2026 and July 27, 2025 'Fiscal Year Ended' is incorrect and unsupported by the evidence.

The header states 'FY2026 Q2' and 'FY2027 Q2' and the subtitle says 'Quarter Ended July 26, 2026 (2027 Q2) and July 27, 2025 (2026 Q2)'. The source evidence confirms these dates correspond to the quarters ended July 26, 2026 and July 27, 2025, respectively, matching Q2 of fiscal years 2027 and 2026. The periods are correctly labeled as quarters ended on those dates, not fiscal year ends. The wording is accurate and consistent with the source.

The evidence explicitly limits 'no material changes' to 'other than the risk factors listed below', implying changes exist inside the listed risk factors. The candidate correctly reflects this exception and uncertainty.
